 Torsion testing devices with international standard diversity 
 25 February 2026 
Originally developed for testing according to ISO 7800, Hegewald & Peschke's torsion testing equipment systems now covers a wide range of international standards, including, among others, the Thai standard TIS 2221-2548, the American standard ASTM A938, as well as ISO 9649 for alternating twist tests to detect near surface defects and determine wire ductility.
Additional testing procedures can be integrated upon customer request – for example, procedures according to EN 10270-1 for spring steel wire. The testing systems are suitable for wires of various dimensions and materials, from fine wire to high-strength wire alloys. Designed for efficient daily laboratory operation, the test benches offer quick and secure sample mounting. Furthermore, the integrated protective hood with viewing window ensures a high-level of safety, which still allows for visual monitoring during testing, making the systems particularly well suited for serial testing and quality assurance routines.
In addition to PLC-operated test benches specifically designed for defined standard tests, flexible twist tests without tensile load can be performed on software-based torsion test benches. The LabMaster testing software handles the precise control of the test parameters, enables intuitive operation, and ensures seamless evaluation and documentation of the results. Test data can be easily integrated into higher level ERP or quality assurance systems via freely configurable interfaces. The software also allows for easy adaptation of the test procedures, enabling the flexible implementation of international or customer specific standards.
